messageFooterPage.title: Message footer
messageFooterPage.description: The line that ends the messages your workspace sends from automations, scheduled sends and team inbox replies.

branding.description: The line added at the bottom of plain text and interactive messages sent from automations, scheduled sends and team inbox replies. Approved templates carry their own text and skip it.

branding.hint: Leave blank to send messages with no footer at all.

branding.tooLong: The footer can be at most {max} characters.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitle: Ask for a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in.
mfa.forcedBanner: Your organization requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to keep using the app.

mfa.offDescription: Two-factor authentication is off. Turn it on to protect your account even if your password leaks.
mfa.step1: Open an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password and similar).
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code, or type the setup key by hand.
mfa.step3: Enter the six-digit code the app shows to finish.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualKeyHint: Use this if you cannot scan the code. Keep it private.
mfa.codeInvalid: Enter the six digits from your app.
mfa.codeWrong: That code is not right or has expired. Wait for a new one and try again.
mfa.expired: This setup expired. Start again to get a new code.
mfa.onDescription: You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app each time you sign in.
mfa.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {You have no recovery codes left.} one {1 recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
mfa.regenerateDescription: This creates ten new codes and makes the old ones stop working. Enter your password to continue.
mfa.disableDescription: Your account will be protected by your password alone. Enter your password to confirm.
mfa.codesTitleEnabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Save your recovery codes.

passkeys.passwordNeeded: It has been a while since you signed in. Enter your password to continue.

problems.unsupported: This device cannot create this kind of passkey. Try another device or a security key.
